paths.name: Path M
paths.desc: Fades a ceiling price has rejected twice (or a floor held twice) on its third test, when at least 2 of RSI, stretch from the mean, volume and the 3-day run agree.

paths.name: Path L
paths.desc: Path D round-number pin bar, skipped when the last 3 daily candles all closed its way or the 3-day run is 1+ daily ATR.

paths.name: Path M control
paths.desc: Path M's structure alone — so RSI, stretch, volume and the run have to beat it to earn their place.

paths.name: Path D
paths.desc: The unguarded Path D setup, traded under the same Lab rules so Path L has something fair to be measured against.

paths.name: Ladder x1.4
paths.desc: The bot's own picks, booked at +35 / +70 / +105 / +140% ROI instead of +25 / +50 / +75 / +100.

paths.name: Ladder x1.4 control
paths.desc: The same picks on today's ladder, so the x1.4 test has a fair baseline under the Lab's own fills and fees.
